evaluation.selection: first unique states from validation sampler seed 0
evaluation.transfer: four reserved performances in round-robin order; reuse reference prediction
evaluation.retrieval: identical retained training features and targets across checkpoints
evaluation.primary: mean of per-state reference and transfer MR-STFT distances, equal weights
evaluation.checkpoint_selection: lowest primary mean among checkpoints with all 21 paired cases scored
evaluation.uncertainty: paired state bootstrap against retrieval, seed 0, 2000 resamples; descriptive, unadjusted for checkpoint selection

constraints.coverage_requirement: verify 205 distinct retained training states; report rejected or missing states explicitly
